manifest.name: dsh-acrylic
manifest.description: Windows 10 (Fluent) acrylic theme for the DSH Web GUI and desktop app: Win10 light/dark --dsw-* token palette, site-wide square corners, and bounded backdrop-filter acrylic on the sidebar, task board and right-hand file panel. Dual-half plugin: a browser half that injects the stylesheet at runtime (required on the desktop app, which serves its window over a custom scheme and never runs webServer.tapIndex) plus a host half for HTTP-served dsh web.
manifest.author: N3kOk0

bundle.text:
# dsh-acrylic bundle layer.
#
# When installed through the official CLI —
#
#   dsh plugin --profile web add link:C:\MaoziFile\Deepseek\dsh-acrylic
#
# — the command reconciles `dsh.profile.bundles` against installed packages and,
# seeing `dsh.bundle.patch` in package.json, appends this package to the bundle
# stack. Profile boot then merges this patch (a single `insert` of the plugin
# row). No profile file edits are needed.
#
# Every key below is restated on purpose: a later layer targeting the same id
# replaces the row's config wholesale.
#
#   enabled       true  -> apply the theme; false -> stock DSH UI, nothing injected
#   acrylic       true  -> master switch for backdrop-filter material
#   panelAcrylic  true  -> DEFAULT ON. Gives the sidebar / task board / file panel
#                          the briefed material: translucent tint + blur(30px)
#                          brightness(120%|80%) saturate(120%) + SVG grain.
#                          This assumes a WALLPAPER or background plugin sits
#                          behind the app — which is what the recipe is for, and
#                          what the blur needs to have anything to act on.
#
#                          Over the app's flat default canvas the blur is a
#                          no-op and a translucent tint can only composite
#                          toward its backdrop, so the panels come out LIGHTER
#                          than their Win10 colours. That is arithmetic, not a
#                          defect. Set this to false for pristine surface
#                          colours until a background is in place.
#
#                          Popup menus are unaffected either way: they float over
#                          live content, so their blur IS visible and they keep
#                          their acrylic via the --dsw-menu-* tokens.
#   square        true  -> site-wide zero corner radius (Win10 geometry)
#   wash          false -> paint a faint gradient behind the layout to stand in
#                          for a wallpaper. Off by default because a real
#                          background supersedes it, and at any useful alpha it
#                          films the whole canvas, including regions with no
#                          panel. Turn it on if you want the blur to show before
#                          the background feature lands.
#
# NOTE for the DESKTOP app: the browser half bakes this config in at build time,
# so changing a key here needs `node scripts/build-client.mjs` and a restart.
# The host half (used by HTTP-served `dsh web`) reads it live.
- insert:
    - id: dsh-acrylic
      name: dsh-acrylic
      config:
        enabled: true
        acrylic: true
        panelAcrylic: true
        square: true
        wash: false

readme.text: **DeepSeek Harness 中的 Windows 10 主题** DSH · Win10 · Fluent 1 · UWP · Acrylic [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-acrylic) [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-acrylic) [](https://github.com/N3kOk0/dsh-acrylic) [](LICENSE)

- Fluent Design 1
- 全面覆盖 DSH 界面
- 完美复刻了 Windows 10 的亚克力效果
- 自定义背景、主题色

桌面端：
- 打开 ```插件```-```添加插件```
- 在弹出的输入框输入 ```dsh-acrylic```
- 点击安装

网页端：
- 在终端运行：
```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-acrylic
```
- 启动 DSH

或
- 把这段话发给你的 Agent
> 请帮我安装 dsh-acrylic 插件（https://github.com/N3kOk0/dsh-acrylic 或 npm 的 dsh-acrylic），无需重启。

**A Windows 10 theme for DeepSeek Harness** DSH · Win10 · Fluent 1 · UWP · Acrylic [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-acrylic) [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-acrylic) [](https://github.com/N3kOk0/dsh-acrylic) [](LICENSE)

- Fluent Design 1
- Full coverage of the DSH interface
- Perfect reproduction of the Windows 10 acrylic effect
- Custom background and accent color

Desktop:
- Open ```Plugins```-```Add plugin```
- In the input field that appears, enter ```dsh-acrylic```
- Click Install

Web:
- Run in a terminal:
```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-acrylic
```
- Start DSH

Or
- Send the following message to the Agent
> Install the dsh-acrylic plugin (https://github.com/N3kOk0/dsh-acrylic or the npm package dsh-acrylic); no restart is required.
